column1: # r3b reviewed 2026-10-26: kept 74, renamed 23, reverted 2, added 2 (left D_ but read)
# b04 round 3: data names owned by effects, battle, animation and HUD modules

column3: Effect_UpdateFootEmitters fills its position/velocity and passes it to Effect_AllocateSprite (step callback Effect_UpdateFootParticle); Player_StateMove fills and allocates it too while running.
Effect_UpdateFootParticle indexes this 12-entry table to set both sprite scale components by age.
Effect_UpdateFootParticle uses this 12-entry table as the env-color alpha by particle age.
Effect_QueueMapObjEmitter increments it for each visible queued emitter; frame loops reset it.
Effect_UpdateAndDrawModelEffects toggles alpha from its low bit and increments it after drawing.
Effect_UpdateMapObjEmitters copies effect_mapobj_emitter_count here; Effect_QueueMapObjEmitter searches that many records of the other (last frame's) buffer to keep an emitter's timer.
Eight records reset and advanced by Effect_ResetFootEmitters and Effect_UpdateFootEmitters.
8 emitter records (timer, x/y/z, size, map object): the current buffer of Effect_QueueMapObjEmitter/Effect_UpdateMapObjEmitters when gfx_frame_index is non-zero (same scheme as mapobj_spinner_buf1).
the other emitter buffer, current when gfx_frame_index is 0 (see effect_mapobj_emitter_buf1).
Ten timed records allocated by Effect_AddFloatingNumber and drawn by Effect_DrawFloatingNumbers.
Eight entries reset by Effect_ResetConvergeEmitters and advanced by Effect_UpdateConvergeEmitters.
Thirty-two model-effect records allocated by Effect_CreateModelEffect and drawn by Effect_UpdateAndDrawModelEffects.
Thirty-two streak records reset, spawned and drawn by the Effect_*Streak functions.

4 timers, one per stat: Effect_StartStatUpMarker(i) sets [i] to 25, Effect_DrawStatUpMarkers draws a marker above player_shadow_pos while non-zero and counts it down, Effect_ResetStatUpMarkers clears them.
Four terrain ring records allocated by Effect_CreateTerrainRing (16 floor-following points), faded by Effect_FadeRing and drawn by Effect_UpdateAndDrawRings.
Effect_UpdateAndDrawModelEffects resets it to FFFF; Effect_ConfigureModelEffectTexture loads a TLUT (effect_model_tlut_ptrs) only when the effect's index differs.
scratch vec2 rotated with Math_RotateVec2 and read back at once: foot-particle velocity in Effect_UpdateFootEmitters, ring point offsets in Effect_CreateTerrainRing.
out record of Effect_CreateTerrainRing's Coll_ResolveFloorAndWalls calls (0xA00): floor y and normal per ring point, flags 0x8000 = no floor.
Function-static sprite descriptor filled from a map-object emitter and passed to Effect_AllocateSprite.
Effect_UpdateMapObjParticle selects env-color alpha from this age-indexed table.
Function-static sprite descriptor filled by Effect_SpawnFlipbookSprite before allocation.
Effect_UpdateFlipbookSprite selects one of three frame addresses by age group.
Effect_UpdateFlipbookSprite indexes the twelve scale values by particle age.
Effect_UpdateFlipbookSprite indexes the twelve alpha values by particle age.
4 RGBA colours: Effect_DrawFloatingNumbers sets the digits' env colour from [number flags & 0xF] (flags from Effect_AddFloatingNumber).
Effect_UpdateConvergeEmitters copies this sprite descriptor (step callback Effect_UpdateConvergeParticle), fills position/velocity/colour and allocates it.
Effect_SpawnBurst copies this descriptor before creating burst particles.

Effect_CreateTerrainRing sets the ring's phase-1 length from [variant]; Effect_UpdateAndDrawRings scales the ring up by sin over that many frames, then leaves phase 1 (it stays until Effect_FadeRing).
Effect_DrawRings indexes these RGB entries by ring variant.
Effect_UpdateAndDrawRings takes the ring alpha from [frame counter & 1] (0xFF/0x96 flicker) before the grow/fade scaling.
Effect_ConfigureModelEffectTexture loads the selected 256-color TLUT through these four addresses.
Effect_DrawStatUpMarkers sets marker i's env colour from [i] (i = the stat passed to Effect_StartStatUpMarker; entry 4 unused).
Effect_UpdateAndDrawSprites calls this display list for each sprite that has no step callback (render mode/combiner setup).
Effect_ResetSpritePool clears it, allocation increments it, drawing decrements it when entries expire.
The 256-entry sprite pool reset, allocated, and drawn by Effect_ResetSpritePool, Effect_AllocateSprite and Effect_DrawSprites.
Effect_LoadSpriteTexture uses these powers of two to select tile mask dimensions.
scratch vec2 rotated with Math_RotateVec2 and read back at once: camera offsets in Battle_UpdateStartCamera, enemy spawn offsets in Battle_SpawnEncounterGroup.
Battle_UpdateStartCamera switches on it (0: view the chosen enemy, 1: wait, then return to the player camera); set to 0 by Battle_TryStartRandomEncounter, 1 by Battle_StartBossEncounter.
Battle_UpdateStartCamera sets 60 after phase 0 and counts it down in phase 1; at 0 it clears battle_flags 0x200 and restores the camera preset.
Math_Rand(enemy_count) at a random encounter (0 for a boss); Battle_UpdateStartCamera points the camera at enemy_slots[it].
Battle_StartBossEncounter and Battle_TryStartRandomEncounter set it; bit 1 is tested as battle-active across player, enemy and HUD code.
Battle_UpdateTurnTransition decrements the delay set when combat starts or a turn ends.
Battle_EndTurn advances this index through D_8007C050 to select the next living enemy.
Battle_SpawnEncounterGroup / Battle_StartBossEncounter set it from enemy_count; the turn-order loops (Battle_EndTurn, Player_FindMeleeTarget) and the drop roll use it as the bound.
Battle setup stores encounter or boss X; rings, camera and movement use it as the combat center.
Battle setup stores encounter or boss Z; rings, camera and movement use it as the combat center.

Battle_UpdateTurnTransition copies the active actor's x here at each turn start (an enemy on enemy turns, the player otherwise) and draws the turn ring around it; Player/Enemy movement is clamped to a radius around it, Player_AddTurnMoveAgilityXP measures from it.
z counterpart of battle_turn_origin_x.
Battle setup assigns 100 or a boss-indexed radius; movement clamps against it and ring creation uses it.

column1: # r3b reverted battle_spawned_actor_ptrs: only written (Battle_StartBossEncounter, Battle_SpawnEncounterGroup, one entry per group), nothing reads it
# r3b reverted battle_spawned_actor_count: only used as the write index of the write-only D_8008BF70

column3: Battle setup stores the slot returned by Effect_CreateTerrainRing and fades it at battle end.
Battle_UpdateTurnTransition stores the ring slot around the active actor and fades it when the turn ends.
Battle_ResetState points it at the selected map encounter-region table; Battle_FindEncounterRegion reads it.
Battle_ResetState points it at the selected map group table; Battle_SpawnEncounterGroup reads entries from it.
Battle_StartBossEncounter saves enemy_anim_tables here before swapping in the boss table; Battle_UpdateTurnTransition restores it when the boss battle is won.
Battle_StartBossEncounter saves enemy_names here before swapping in the boss names; Battle_UpdateTurnTransition restores it when the boss battle is won.
Battle_StartBossEncounter copies D_8007C140 here; defeat handling and arena radius use its value minus one.
Battle_TryStartRandomEncounter adds player travel to this float and tests it against 50.
Battle_TryStartRandomEncounter raises this threshold and compares it with Math_Rand(2000).
Battle_UpdateTurnCamera indexes this table to adjust camera position and distance.
Battle_StartBossEncounter indexes this eight-entry radius table by boss ID.
Anim_DrawNode stores up to four transformed node positions here; player code reads the first.
Anim_DrawModel clears it and Anim_DrawNode increments it when saving node positions.
Anim_DrawNode builds an aim-at-camera matrix here and converts it to an N64 matrix.
Hud_DrawNpcTalkMarker advances this angle and uses its sine for marker bobbing.
Hud_UpdateElementAllocation sets bit 0 when a point is spent; when hud_element_input_timer then runs out it clears core_flags 8 (closes the panel) and toggles the bit off.
Hud_DrawClippedTextureRect rejects and clips rectangles against this left X bound.
Hud_DrawClippedTextureRect rejects and clips rectangles against this top Y bound.
Hud_DrawClippedTextureRect rejects and clips rectangles against this right X bound.
Hud_DrawSpiritMarker advances this angle and uses its sine for marker bobbing.
Hud_DrawClippedTextureRect rejects and clips rectangles against this bottom Y bound.
Eight timed popup entries reset, allocated and drawn by the Hud_*Popup functions.
Hud_UpdateElementAllocation sets 30 on a gain; Hud_DrawElementLevels uses it for fade alpha.
Hud_UpdateElementAllocation maps directional input to this 0..3 index and increments its level.
scratch Vec3f: rotated with Math_RotateVec2 for the compass marker in Hud_DrawCompass; filled (x, y, 1.0) and passed to Magic_CreateVisualEffect by Hud_StartActorStatusIndicator.
Hud_DrawChestMarker and Hud_DrawTextSpotMarker use the two angle elements for bobbing.
Hud_DrawMeleeTargetMarker advances this angle and uses its sine for marker bobbing.
Hud_Draw counts it up to 12 / down to 0 by hud_panel_transition_state; the meter and element panels slide out by its square; death and 1870 set 12.
Hud_Draw switches this state among entering, exiting and idle as HUD panels change.
Hud_DrawPlayerMeters eases this value toward current HP divided by maximum HP times 56 and draws the first bar.
Hud_DrawPlayerMeters eases this value toward current MP divided by maximum MP times 56 and draws the second bar.
Player_HandleSpellInput sets 8 when a direction is added or removed; Hud_DrawSpellInput and Hud_DrawSpellName use it for the slide/fade and the new-icon flash and count it down.

Player_HandleSpellInput: bit 0 set when an input is added (Hud_DrawSpellInput flashes the new element icon), cleared on removal; bit 1 set for the first input (Hud_DrawSpellInput/Hud_DrawSpellName slide the panel in).
Player_StartCastSpell sets 30; Hud_Draw calls Hud_DrawSpellName and counts it down while non-zero.

set to 8 when the element-allocation panel opens (Player_Update on a spirit, Player_UpdateStatGrowth on a level-up) and after each point; Hud_UpdateElementAllocation slides/fades the panel with it and takes input only at 0.

Enemy_StateIdle sets 60 when an enemy's turn starts; Hud_Draw draws Hud_DrawEnemyInfoPanel (name, numbers) while it is non-zero in battle and counts it down, the panel slides in over the first 10 frames; cleared at battle end.
Core_RunGameplayLoop: when not -1 and Audio_GetSeqState(0) == 0, Audio_LoadSeq(0, it) then -1; Hud_ResetState sets -1 (no other writer in the code).
HUD draw routines set this X origin for panels, meters and clipped texture rectangles.
HUD draw routines set this Y origin for panels, meters and clipped texture rectangles.
Hud_DrawNpcTalkMarker writes projected screen Y here and uses it to place the marker.
Hud_DrawElementLevels advances this sine angle for the pulsing element icons.

6-glyph string (asset): Hud_DrawSpellLabel draws it instead of the spell's name when Magic_GetSpellRestrictionFlags returns bit 4 (player's element level below the spell's requirement). 'locked' is a reading of that bit.
4 RGBA element colours: Hud_DrawElementLevels, Hud_DrawSpellInput and Hud_UpdateElementAllocation index it by element.
7 status bits (+0): Hud_StartActorStatusIndicator stores an icon for the first matching mask, Hud_UpdateAndDrawActorStatusIndicators draws the icons and clears one when its status bit goes.

4 status bits: Hud_StartActorStatusIndicator starts a Magic_CreateVisualEffect on the actor for a matching status; Hud_UpdateAndDrawActorStatusIndicators keeps it on the actor and ends it when the status bit clears.

{0x1000..0x8000}: player_state flag bit per element, set when that element level is 50 (Player_Spawn, Hud_UpdateElementAllocation); Hud_DrawElementLevels draws a pulsing overlay on each element whose bit is set.
Hud_DrawSpellInput selects one of these four X/Y icon positions by recent input direction.
Hud_UpdateElementAllocation selects one of these four X/Y positions by element index.
same bits as hud_element_max_level_masks: Hud_UpdateElementAllocation ORs [element] into the player flags when the element reaches level 50 (the cap).
Hud_DrawSpellLabel passes [Magic_GetSpellRestrictionFlags result] as Hud_DrawGlyphString's palette (index into D_803A8778): 0 usable, 1 MP short, 2 otherwise.
